Zip data

The zip data custom step allows SAS Studio users to move or copy data to ZIP files.

The custom step includes options to specify:
- the source directory
- the source file pattern e.g. *.sas7bdat
- the target directory
- the period before which files should be archived
- whether to move or copy files to the ZIP file
- whether to do a "dry-run"

Tested on SAS Viya Stable 2024.05, with Python 3.9.16 and dateutil 2.9.0.post0.

Python must be configured on the SAS Viya platform.

Custom step options

> Source data

Source directory
Default: None
Description: Source directory on the file system. Directories in SAS Content are not supported

Source filename pattern
Default: *
Description: Filename pattern used to match files in the source directory e.g. *.sas7bdat. See the glob module https://docs.python.org/3/library/glob.html for details

> Target data

Target directory
Default: None
Description: Target directory on the file system. Directories in SAS Content are not supported

> Archive period

Archive files with a last modified date-time before a given period. The period is specified as a number and a unit e.g. 1 month. The cutoff is calculated with dateutil.relativedelta https://dateutil.readthedocs.io/en/stable/relativedelta.html

Number
Default: 1
Description: Number of periods

Units
Default: months
Description: Period unit. Select from minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years

> Action

Action
Default: Move
Description: Move or copy files to a ZIP file

Dry run
Default: False
Description: If True, the step will run but not execute the archive step

For each file in the source directory that matches the file name pattern and modified date-time constraints, a ZIP file will be created in the archive directory.

For example, if the following source files match:
[source dir]/class.sas7bdat
[source dir]/classfit.sas7bdat

Then the step will create:
[target dir]/class.sas7bdat.zip
[target dir]/classfit.sas7bdat.zip
